title: SLAP2-to-HARP cycle-clock correspondence
source: Session registry; SLAP2 SummaryLoCo/dendriticVoltageSummary acquisition metadata; HARP_df DI3
method: Period from long contiguous DI3 epochs compared to linesPerCycle/lineRateHz; integer-line cadence classified separately.
interpretation: Distribution near zero supports that DI3 measures the expected SLAP2 acquisition cadence.
limitation: A cadence match does not independently measure electrical latency or prove an absolute source start offset.

title: Cycle-clock agreement across acquisition stages
source: Same inputs as Figure 01, grouped by A0–B2 stage.
method: Long-epoch HARP edge period compared to the nominal SLAP2 DMD cycle; p95 within-epoch DI3 period jitter.
interpretation: Identifies whether timing agreement varies systematically with experimental stage.
limitation: HARP timestamp granularity contributes to measured interval jitter; irregular/off-epoch gaps excluded.

title: Clock pulse overlays · 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47
method: Reconstruct SLAP2 cycle boundaries from nominal source lineRateHz and linesPerCycle; set epoch origin at first HARP DI3 edge; overlay pulse times over 60 s, 1 s, 200 ms.
interpretation: Demonstrates cadence coincidence and any divergence at progressively finer time scales.
limitation: Nominal SLAP2 ticks are constructed, not a second recorded signal; zero lag at epoch start is defined by construction.

title: Epoch-local cadence drift · 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47

title: Across-session cycle cadence drift and pulse continuity
source: Per-session HARP DI3 rising edges and source linesPerCycle/lineRateHz; accepted acquisition epochs.
method: Absolute end-of-epoch DI3 minus nominal source-cycle displacement after first-pulse anchoring; interval departures beyond 0.5×–1.5× nominal.
interpretation: Characterizes source-cadence plausibility, rate mismatch and unexpected pulse intervals without counting expected recording-window overhang as dropouts.
limitation: End-point displacement is affected by nominal acquisition-rate accuracy and epoch length; not a measured electrical synchronization offset.

title: Session distributions of anchored clock discrepancy
source: HARP DI3 rising edges; SLAP2 source linesPerCycle and lineRateHz; registry session stage.
method: Difference between real HARP DI3 edges and SLAP2 nominal cycle ordinal prediction; set first DI3 edge to nominal index zero in each epoch.
interpretation: Quantifies within-epoch rate agreement and accumulation across sessions; closest testable alternative to a mean electrical edge lag.
limitation: Anchoring imposes zero initial lag. Values are NOT an independently measured SLAP2-to-HARP electrical delay.

title: Source acquisition versus HARP DI3 recording window · 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47
method: Measure acquisition durations independently. Upper: nested durations under an explicitly ASSUMED common start; lower: observed DI3 epoch bounds on HARP clock.
interpretation: Demonstrates why total source and HARP pulse counts need not match and why tail clipping is expected for longer source streams.
limitation: Absolute SLAP2 start/end in HARP time not measured. Upper nesting is a visualization of durations, not independent proof of boundary registration.

title: Acquisition-duration differences across sessions
source: SLAP2 source metadata per epoch and HARP DI3 rising-edge segments, grouped by registry session_type.
method: Difference between summed source nominal duration and summed measured HARP DI3 epoch duration.
interpretation: Reports expected additional source acquisition outside the HARP-recorded window; can identify anomalously large differences.

method: Monotonic nearest matched corrected predicted transitions compared to analog photodiode threshold crossings. Encoded uses rising edges; legacy uses frame-modulo edges.

title: Recorded screen-transition phase within SLAP2 acquisition cycles
source: HARP photodiode.pkl and HARP_df DI3 rising edges for sessions with available native-clock indices.
method: Median signed event-to-nearest-clock phase and its p95 magnitude per session. Focus-only subset unless full PD scan enabled.
interpretation: Shows display-to-imaging hardware timing on a common recorded clock, with inter-session variability.
limitation: Phase is not misalignment; absent or nonoverlapping native HARP indices are excluded rather than shifted to match.

title: BonVision/HARP timing distributions by alignment method
source: Saved analysis/qc/behavior/alignment_meta.json (left); corrected BV CSV and HARP analog photodiode.pkl (middle/right).
method: Saved HARP/BV interval RMSE shown separately from real paired-event residual p95 and within-frame fraction. Colored by original alignment method.
interpretation: Quantifies precision of both synchronization algorithms across eligible sessions and reveals session variability.
limitation: Interval RMSE is NOT point-wise lag. Paired-event error is fitted consistency, not independent ground truth; full-event columns only cover scanned sessions.
